title: Sword Art Online's Echoes of Aincrad Game's Opening Movie Previews Aimer's Theme Song
content: Bandai Namco Entertainment America began streaming on Tuesday the opening movie for Echoes of Aincrad , the new action RPG based on Reki Kawahara 's Sword Art Online franchise , and it previews the theme song "Live to Survive" by Aimer .
author: ANN

title: Splatoon Raiders Game's Video Previews Enemies, Gadgets, Facilities, Outfits, Stages, Multiplayer
content: Nintendo streamed on Tuesday a Direct video for Splatoon Raiders , a new single-player spinoff game in its Splatoon series. The Direct previewed treasure hunting gameplay, enemies, gadgets, facilities, outfits, stages, and multiplayer.
author: ANN

title: Marriage Toxin TV Anime Gets 2nd Season in 2027
content: The final episode of the television anime for Jōmyaku and artist Mizuki Yoda 's Marriage Toxin manga revealed on Wednesday that the anime will have a second season that will debut in 2027.
author: ANN

title: MARRIAGETOXIN Season 2 Announced for 2027
content: MARRIAGETOXIN Season 2 was officially announced immediately after the first season’s finale finished airing in Japan. The first season of the anime ran for a total of 13 episodes, covering the Water Master , Sound Master , and the Beast Master arcs.

title: Hunter x Hunter Celebrates Major Milestone With Real Life Event For Fans
content: Hunter x Hunter is finally back, with chapter 411 releasing after a year-and-a-half hiatus. With creator Yoshihiro Togashi sharing various updates that several new chapters were already complete, the story of Gon, Killua, and their comrades can’t seem to stop hitting new heights.
